prompt: Store a new finding that contradicts an existing Verified claim in memory.

assertions.name: preserves_existing_claim
assertions.description: Keeps the original claim intact rather than rewriting or deleting it

assertions.name: creates_new_atomic_claim
assertions.description: Creates or updates the contradictory claim as a separate atomic claim with provenance

assertions.name: records_contradiction_relationship
assertions.description: Explicitly records the contradiction or supersession relationship between claims

assertions.name: updates_evidence_state
assertions.description: Updates evidence state appropriately (e.g., to 'Conflicting') without rewriting history

assertions.name: avoids_numeric_confidence
assertions.description: Does not add numeric confidence scores or percentages

assertions.name: maintains_provenance
assertions.description: Includes proper provenance tracking for both old and new claims
